title: Gridworld Transition Function
learning_objectives: Encode an environment as states, actions, rewards and terminal flags
Implement deterministic transitions with walls and boundaries
Build the full transition table P
hints: Target `(r + dr, c + dc)`; if outside or a wall, stay.
Reward/done from the target cell: G → (10, True), X → (−10, True), else (−1, False).

failure_feedback.advice: State id = row * n_cols + col; action 1 = right, 2 = down.
Moves into walls or off-grid keep the agent in place with reward −1.
Goal gives +10 and pit −10, both terminal.
Terminal and wall states map to themselves with reward 0 and done=True.
